definitions.gloss: before that; previously; prior to that
definitions.explanation: refers to the time period before a previously mentioned event or point in time

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す{前|まえ}、その{前|まえ}は{大阪|おおさか}に{住|す}んでいた。
examples.english: Before moving to Tokyo, before that I lived in Osaka.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}が{始|はじ}まる。その{前|まえ}に{資料|しりょう}を{確認|かくにん}しよう。
examples.english: The meeting will start. Let's check the documents before that.

examples.japanese: その{前|まえ}の{週|しゅう}は{忙|いそが}しかった。
examples.english: The week before that was busy.

notes:
Compound of その (that) + {前|まえ} (before). Refers to the time period before a previously mentioned event.

USAGE:
- Time: before that event — その{前|まえ}に{準備|じゅんび}する (prepare before that)
- Position: in front of that — その{前|まえ}に{立|た}つ (stand in front of that)
- Noun modifier: その{前|まえ}の + noun — その{前|まえ}の{週|しゅう} (the week before that)

RELATED その + NOUN PATTERNS:
- その{後|ご}/{後|あと}: after that
- その{間|あいだ}: meanwhile, during that time
- その{時|とき}: at that time
- そのため: therefore, for that reason

SIMILAR WORDS:
- その{前|まえ}: before that (specific reference)
- {以前|いぜん}: before, previously (more formal, can be vaguer)
